answer: AR01, AR05, AR08, AR11 and AR12 chosen
analyst_test: With every file conformed and every rule read, the easy route takes each region's error rate as the share of its audited records found in error; but the audit took records the risk screen flagged at about thirty times the rate of unflagged records, and flagged records are in error far more often, so the audited share overstates every region's error rate, most where flagged records are a small part of the register, and only weighting each audited record by the inverse of its chance of being drawn estimates the register's own rate.
domain_test: Estimating a register's error rate from a quality audit sample, worked the way official statistics estimates from an unequal-probability sample: each audited record stands for the records of its stratum in the register, weighted by the inverse of its stratum's sampling fraction (Horvitz-Thompson), the strata here the risk screen's flag; with another field's nouns there is no administrative register audited against its source and no screen that drives the selection.

stakeholder_role: head of register quality at a national statistics office

spine.entity: one business record on the register

driver: A rate over a whole list is read from an audit of a sample drawn at very different rates for the members a screen flagged and the rest, and the flagged members carry the outcome far more often; the audited share overstates the rate wherever flagged members are a small part of the list, and only weighting each audited member by the inverse of its chance of being drawn, a chance recorded only in the screen's own output, recovers the list's rate.
driver_concrete: The summer audit drew 60 per cent of the records the automated risk screen had flagged and 2 per cent of the rest, and a flagged record is in error about one time in four against one in fifty for the rest; each region's audited error share, 10 to 14 per cent, overstates its register's rate, 2 to 6 per cent, by how small a part of its register the screen flagged.
stump: The default path takes each region's share of its audited records in error and files AR01, AR02, AR04, AR05, AR06, AR07, AR08, AR10, AR11, AR12 and AR13 chosen, because it never asks how the audit drew its records: it took close to a quarter of the records the May risk screen referred and one in twenty-five of the rest, the referred records are in error far more often, and a region's register error rate is its strata's audited rates carried to the records each stratum holds.

differentiation.task479: task479 weighs each employer's noisy experience against the pool's by credibility; here no unit's record is noisy: each region's audit is large, and its share is biased by how the sample was drawn, corrected by inverse-probability weights from the screen's output.
differentiation.task473: task473 estimates, from units tested regardless, the share of cases an observer notices at each trait level and divides each positive by it; here no detection is modelled and no trait level enters: the audit's own draw rates by the screen's flag, fixed by the counts drawn and on the register, weight each audited record, and the outcome is an error rate, not a count.
differentiation.task458: task458 counts trait-holders through events logged while units are observed, the observed share selected on the trait; here every record is on the register and observed, and only the audit's sample is drawn unequally, by a recorded flag.
differentiation.task233: task233 carries a missing group's departure from imputed values measured on a follow-up; here nothing is missing or imputed: the audited records are a stratified sample whose strata the screen's output records.

lineage.driver: A combined return reports one total for several units, and each unit's share is split by its head count, which gives every unit the group's average; but the item follows an activity whose unit cost differs several-fold across kinds, and the units inside the return do mostly the cheap kind, which the units that report alone measure, so the split by head count overstates the units inside and keeps them out of the lowest ranks.
